name: MaxChadz
description: Meet the 6969 MaxChadz, an intrepid and charismatic fellowship on an extraordinary cosmic odyssey. Enchanted by the enigmatic teachings of the Book of Chad, this elite crew embarks on a quest to unveil the elusive MaxBabz. Join their epic adventure as they navigate the Ethscriptions universe.
